info.title: Creditcoin3 Node JSON-RPC API
info.description:
JSON-RPC methods exposed by the Creditcoin3 node. The node presents a hybrid interface: Ethereum-compatible EVM methods (via Frontier) alongside Substrate node/state methods, including the newer Substrate JSON-RPC spec-v2 API (chainHead/chainSpec/archive/transaction).

Each method carries an `x-availability` extension:
- `public`: callable on public endpoints (default `--rpc-methods=Auto`).
- `unsafe-local-only`: advertised by `rpc_methods` but only callable over localhost.
- `opt-in-ethapi`: only present when the node is started with `--ethapi debug,trace` (NOT exposed on mainnet).
- `dev-sealing`: only present on dev nodes started with `--sealing` (NOT exposed on mainnet).

The public method set was verified against mainnet (`rpc_methods`).
